dogecoin.text:
📰 AMC is now letting you buy movie tickets with Dogecoin

- AMC’s mobile app now supports purchasing tickets and concessions using Dogecoin and Shiba Inu cryptocurrency, which may appeal to the “meme stock” crowd that has driven up the prices of its shares. https://t.co/xihUYj3AE6
